```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

library(plotly)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(arrow)
library(umap)
library(htmltools)
library(forcats)
# -----------------------------
# Load data
# -----------------------------
parquet_path <- params$parquet_path
metadata_path <- params$metadata_path
Name <-  params$AuthorName
Sample_Name <-params$SampleName
df <- open_dataset(parquet_path) %>% collect()
metadata <- read.csv(metadata_path) %>%
  dplyr::rename(identifier = Transdecoder_ID)

df_annotated <- df %>%
  left_join(metadata, by = "identifier")
```

```{r,echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
make_umap_plot <- function(df, color_col) {
  
values <- df[[color_col]]
  

# -----------------------------
# CATEGORICAL CASE
# -----------------------------
df[[color_col]] <- fct_explicit_na(
  as.factor(values),
  na_level = "NA"
)

fig <- plot_ly(
  data = df,
  x = ~x,
  y = ~y,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers",
  color = df[[color_col]],
  colors = "Set2",
  size = 3,
  text = ~paste0(
    "ID: ", identifier,
    "<br>", color_col, ": ", .data[[color_col]]
  ),
  hoverinfo = "text"
)


fig %>% layout(
title = color_col,
plot_bgcolor = "#e5ecf6",
xaxis = list(title = "UMAP 1"),
yaxis = list(title = "UMAP 2")
) %>%
    layout(showlegend = FALSE) %>%
    layout(
      paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",  # transparent outer background
      plot_bgcolor  = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",  # transparent plot area
      
      font = list(color = "white"),     # all text white
      
      xaxis = list(
        color = "white",
        gridcolor = "rgba(255,255,255,0.1)",
        zerolinecolor = "rgba(255,255,255,0.2)"
      ),
      
      yaxis = list(
        color = "white",
        gridcolor = "rgba(255,255,255,0.1)",
        zerolinecolor = "rgba(255,255,255,0.2)"
      ))
}      
```


```{r,echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE,results='asis'}
color_columns <- c(
  "Domain_Label",
  "Hit",
  "Annotation_Source",
  "Category"
)

fig_list <- lapply(color_columns, function(col) {
  make_umap_plot(df_annotated, col)
})

fig1 <-  fig_list[[1]] #domain label 
fig2 <-  fig_list[[2]] #Tox/NonTox/NA Uniprot 3
fig3 <-  fig_list[[3]] #Category 4
fig4 <-  fig_list[[4]] #strict/lax 2

div(
  style = "display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 12px; padding-top:50px",
  
  lapply(fig_list, function(fig) {
    div(
      style = "height: 350; overflow-y: auto; border: 0 px;",
      fig
    )
  })
)

```
Above plots show select annotations over ProtSpace generated UMAP projections. To explore complete ProtSpace results, upload .parquetbundle file generated by VenomflowAnalysis on the [ProtSpace explore page](https://protspace.app/explore)
